item.description:
Release v5.1.0

Changes since v4.19.0

  • bugfix: fix a bug
  • docs: add AgentTool dynamic injection proposal
  • docs: add comprehensive usage examples and tests
  • docs: add plan for restoring provider management settings
  • docs: restore documentation files
  • docs: update legacy items status in agenttool proposal
  • docs(LumiComponentAgentTool): add README and gitignore
  • docs(LumiComponentLLMProvider): add README and gitignore
  • docs(LumiComponentMenuBar): add README and gitignore
  • docs(LumiComponentOverlay): add README and gitignore
  • docs(LumiComponentPanelChrome): add README and gitignore
  • docs(LumiComponentStorage): add README and gitignore
  • docs(LumiComponentSubAgent): add README and gitignore
  • docs(plugins): add README and update .gitignore for core plugins
  • feat: add AgentToolPlugin implementing AgentToolProviding
  • feat: Add AgentTurnRunnerPlugin for agent turn execution
  • feat: add command registry for plugin menu injection
  • feat: add ConversationSpeedPlugin to display streaming TPS in chat toolbar
  • feat: add EditorFileTreeV2Plugin with simple file tree for RailView
  • feat: add EditorKernelPlugin and ChatKernelPlugin
